Landing.title: AI Code Review for GitHub
Landing.subtitle: Find bugs, security issues and performance problems before they reach production.
Landing.footerTagline: Calytrix reviews pull request diffs with Claude. It never runs your code.

ConnectGithub.title: Connect your GitHub account
ConnectGithub.subtitle: To review pull requests, connect your GitHub account. Calytrix only requests read access to your repositories and pull requests.

Dashboard.title: Your repositories
Dashboard.subtitle: Pick a repository to review its pull requests.
Dashboard.empty: No repositories found on your GitHub account.

Repo.subtitle: Select a pull request to review.
Repo.empty: No pull requests found in this repository.

Pull.staleNotice: This pull request has new commits since the last review. Re-review to see up-to-date results.
